repair_summary: QM_FrameworkInitCoreAfterRuntimeStateArmed already logged 5 of 8 internal rejection branches via QM_LogEvent(QM_ERROR,"FRAMEWORK_INIT_FAILED",...): runtime_state_not_armed, ea_id_non_positive, portfolio_weight_out_of_range, risk_inputs_invalid, magic_resolution_failed. The rootcause doc (oninit_rootcause_4216dd75.md) undercounted this; static reading of the current source found 3 further return-false branches in the SAME function that were still silent: QM_RiskSizerConfigure failure, QM_EntryPatternConfigure failure (both affected EAs lack QM_PATTERN_PERMISSION_EA_MANAGED, so this branch is live for them), and QM_ChartUI_Init failure. Each now emits the same reason-tagged QM_LogEvent before returning false.

QM_RuntimeExecutionBeginLegacyInitialization() (QM_RuntimeExecutionContract.mqh) had one bare return false (LEGACY_INIT_AFTER_CONTRACT_REFUSED) with no Print/QM_LogEvent at all; it now logs the same way. This file previously relied on include order for QM_LogEvent visibility (only safe because every current caller happens to include QM_Logger.mqh first); added an explicit #include "QM_Logger.mqh" inside its own header guard so the file is self-sufficient and does not silently break a caller that includes it directly (e.g. framework/tests/unit/runtime_execution_contract_smoke.mq5, which previously included only this file).

All changes are additive logging only (QM_LogEvent lines placed immediately before each existing return false). No control-flow, threshold, gate, risk, or economics logic was changed. No behavior changes for any already-passing EA.

scope.note: cross_ea=true because the two edited files are shared includes used by every V5 EA; compile_ea=false because no COMPILE_EA work item was enqueued this cycle -- see README.md for why, and the recommended follow-up.
